notes.bukhari:1518: Read both own fields completely. Hindi has an abbreviated/damaged opening route and prints the female name as ऐसा and the departure place as तांईं; preserve those source spellings without inserting Urdu's fuller route, Aisha spelling or Tanim spelling. Keep the woman's actual others-have-performed/I-could-not contrast, the instruction to Abdur Rahman concerning his sister, the riding-behind action and the actual subsequent Umrah. Urdu independently supplies its own fuller named wording. Separate pure prefatory routes, retain the female source attribution as qualified in Hindi, and keep the actual sibling relationship and actions.
notes.bukhari:1520: Both full fields supply Aisha's question comparing jihad with other good deeds and asking why they should not do it, followed by the actual no/better answer naming Hajj that is mabrur. Preserve both the negation and mabrur qualification under the two actual voices; do not generalize it into a present-day instruction or add an unstated group. Separate the preceding multistep transmission route from the final reporter framing and question.
notes.bukhari:1522: Both complete fields contain Zayd ibn Jubayr's actual visit to Ibn Umar's residence, the tent/curtain description, his Umrah-ihram question and Ibn Umar's reply reporting the Prophet's three named place/group assignments. Preserve the visit rather than classifying every reported-visit clause as isnad. The internal parenthetic Zayd-said phrase returns the actual questioner's voice after the setting and remains material narrator framing. Keep each own place spelling and all three people/place pairs. Separate only the earlier transmitter route, not this actual encounter.
notes.bukhari:1523: Both full fields supply Ibn Abbas's historical report of Yemenis arriving for Hajj without travel provisions, their reliance claim, begging on arrival in Mecca, and the explicitly reported revelation event with the source's verse rendering. Preserve the quotation as the supplied subject of that actual revelation report, without inventing recitation, Arabic wording or an external verse mapping. The final Ibn Uyaynah/Amr/Ikrimah mursal notice and prefatory route are apparatus; they do not supply another body.
notes.bukhari:1526: Both complete fields supply four location/group assignments, applicability to nonlocals passing those regions, the intention of Hajj or Umrah, and the final Mecca-resident case. Preserve every named pairing, alternative and visitor/intention condition. Both own fields have an abbreviated join after people living inside the miqat before the Mecca case; preserve and qualify that join without inserting the familiar missing general-resident rule from memory or another version. The earlier multistep route is context.
